Introduction
1 Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled[a] among us, 2 just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word. 3 With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent __RECIPIENT_A__, 4 so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist Foretold
5 In the time of __RULER_A__ king of Judea there was a __WORKER_A__ named __PERSON_A__, who belonged to the priestly division of __DIVISION_A__; his wife __PERSON_B__ was also a descendant of __FOREFATHER_B__. 6 Both of them were righteous in the sight of __MOST_HIGH_A__, observing all the __MASTER_A__ commands and decrees blamelessly. 7 But they were childless because __PERSON_B__ was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

8 Once when __PERSON_A__ division was on duty and he was serving as __WORKER_A__ before __MOST_HIGH_A__, 9 he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the __PLACE_A__ of the __MASTER_A__ and burn __MATERIAL_A__. 10 And when the time for the burning of __MATERIAL_A__ came, all the assembled worshipers were __REQUEST_A__ outside.

11 Then an angel of the __MASTER_A__ appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of __MATERIAL_A__. 12 When __PERSON_A__ saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear. 13 But the angel said to him: “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_A__; your __REQUEST_A__ has been heard. Your wife __PERSON_B__ will bear you a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_C__. 14 He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth, 15 for he will be great in the sight of the __MASTER_A__. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ even before he is born. 16 He will bring back many of the people of __PEOPLE_A__ to the __MASTER_A__ their __MOST_HIGH_A__. 17 And he will go on before the __MASTER_A__, in the spirit and power of __PROPHET_A__, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the __MASTER_A__.”

18 __PERSON_A__ asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years.”

19 The angel said to him, “I am __MESSENGER_B__. I stand in the presence of __MOST_HIGH_A__, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news. 20 And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time.”

21 Meanwhile, the people were waiting for __PERSON_A__ and wondering why he stayed so long in the __PLACE_A__. 22 When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the __PLACE_A__, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

23 When his time of service was completed, he returned home. 24 After this his wife __PERSON_B__ became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. 25 “The __MASTER_A__ has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

The Birth of __PERSON_F__ Foretold
26 In the sixth month of __PERSON_B__ pregnancy, __MOST_HIGH_A__ sent the angel __MESSENGER_B__ to __VILLAGE_A__, a town in __REGION_A__, 27 to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named __PERSON_E__, a descendant of __KING_A__. The virgin’s name was __PERSON_D__. 28 The angel went to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The __MASTER_A__ is with you.”

29 __PERSON_D__ was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be. 30 But the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_D__; you have found favor with __MOST_HIGH_A__. 31 You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_F__. 32 He will be great and will be called the Son of the __HONORED_A__. The __MASTER_A__ __MOST_HIGH_A__ will give him the throne of his father __KING_A__, 33 and he will reign over __ANCESTOR_B__ descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.”

34 “How will this be,” __PERSON_D__ asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”

35 The angel answered, “The __SPIRIT_A__ will come on you, and the power of the __HONORED_A__ will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called[b] the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__. 36 Even __PERSON_B__ your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be unable to conceive is in her sixth month. 37 For no word from __MOST_HIGH_A__ will ever fail.”

38 “I am the __MASTER_A__ servant,” __PERSON_D__ answered. “May your word to me be fulfilled.” Then the angel left her.

__PERSON_D__ Visits __PERSON_B__
39 At that time __PERSON_D__ got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea, 40 where she entered __PERSON_A__ home and greeted __PERSON_B__. 41 When __PERSON_B__ heard __PERSON_D__ greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and __PERSON_B__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__. 42 In a loud voice she exclaimed: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear! 43 But why am I so favored, that the mother of my __MASTER_A__ should come to me? 44 As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy. 45 Blessed is she who has believed that the __MASTER_A__ would fulfill his promises to her!”

__PERSON_D__ Song
46 And __PERSON_D__ said:

“My soul glorifies the __MASTER_A__
47     and my spirit rejoices in __MOST_HIGH_A__ my Savior,
48 for he has been mindful
    of the humble state of his servant.
From now on all generations will call me blessed,
49     for the Mighty One has done great things for me—
    holy is his name.
50 His mercy extends to those who fear him,
    from generation to generation.
51 He has performed mighty deeds with his arm;
    he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.
52 He has brought down rulers from their thrones
    but has lifted up the humble.
53 He has filled the hungry with good things
    but has sent the rich away empty.
54 He has helped his servant __PEOPLE_A__,
    remembering to be merciful
55 to __ANCESTOR_A__ and his descendants forever,
    just as he promised our ancestors.”

56 __PERSON_D__ stayed with __PERSON_B__ for about three months and then returned home.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist
57 When it was time for __PERSON_B__ to have her baby, she gave birth to a son. 58 Her neighbors and relatives heard that the __MASTER_A__ had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

59 On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father __PERSON_A__, 60 but his mother spoke up and said, “No! He is to be called __PERSON_C__.”

61 They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who has that name.”

62 Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child. 63 He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is __PERSON_C__.” 64 Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising __MOST_HIGH_A__. 65 All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things. 66 Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this child going to be?” For the __MASTER_A__ hand was with him.

__PERSON_A__ Song
67 His father __PERSON_A__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ and prophesied:

68 “Praise be to the __MASTER_A__, the __MOST_HIGH_A__ of __PEOPLE_A__,
    because he has come to his people and redeemed them.
69 He has raised up a horn[c] of salvation for us
    in the house of his servant __KING_A__
70 (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),
71 salvation from our enemies
    and from the hand of all who hate us—
72 to show mercy to our ancestors
    and to remember his holy covenant,
73     the oath he swore to our father __ANCESTOR_A__:
74 to rescue us from the hand of our enemies,
    and to enable us to serve him without fear
75     in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

76 And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the __HONORED_A__;
    for you will go on before the __MASTER_A__ to prepare the way for him,
77 to give his people the knowledge of salvation
    through the forgiveness of their sins,
78 because of the tender mercy of our __MOST_HIGH_A__,
    by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
79 to shine on those living in darkness
    and in the shadow of death,
to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

80 And the child grew and became strong in spirit[d]; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to __PEOPLE_A__.
translations:
介绍  
1 许多人已经开始写下在我们中间已经成就的事情[a]，2 就像他们从一开始目击者和话语的仆人那里传下来一样。3 注意这点，因为我自己已经从开始细致调查一切，我也决意为你写一个有条理的记载，尊贵的 __RECIPIENT_A__，4 这样你可以知道你所学的事情的确定性。  

先知 __PERSON_C__ 出生预告  
5 在犹太王 __RULER_A__ 时代，有一个名叫 __PERSON_A__ 的 __WORKER_A__，他属于 __DIVISION_A__ 祭司班组；他的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 也是 __FOREFATHER_B__ 的后代。6 他们在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前是正义人的，遵守所有 __MASTER_A__ 的命令和律例，没有瑕疵。7 但他们没有孩子，因为 __PERSON_B__ 不能怀孕，他们两人都非常老。  

8 一次，当 __PERSON_A__ 所属的班组值班，他在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前服侍时，9 按照祭司制度，他被抽签选中进入 __MASTER_A__ 的 __PLACE_A__ 烧 __MATERIAL_A__。10 当烧 __MATERIAL_A__ 的时间来临时，所有聚集的敬拜者被叫到外面 __REQUEST_A__。  

11 那时 __MASTER_A__ 的一个天使出现在他面前，站在 __MATERIAL_A__ 祭坛右边。12 __PERSON_A__ 看到他，害怕得惊慌失措。13 天使对他说：“不要怕，__PERSON_A__；你的 __REQUEST_A__ 被听见了。你的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名 __PERSON_C__。14 他将成为你喜乐和欢喜，很多人因他的出生会欢欣。15 他在 __MASTER_A__ 面前将是伟大的。他绝不可喝酒和发酵饮料，他出生前就满有 __SPIRIT_A__。16 他要带回许多 __PEOPLE_A__ 人归向 __MASTER_A__ 他们的 __MOST_HIGH_A__。17 他要在 __MASTER_A__ 面前，用 __PROPHET_A__ 的灵和权能，转化父母的心归向子女，使不顺服的人转向义人的智慧，为 __MASTER_A__ 预备百姓。”  

18 __PERSON_A__ 问天使：“我怎能确定这事？我已经老了，我妻子年纪也大。”  

19 天使说：“我是 __MESSENGER_B__。我站在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 前面，奉派对你说话，告诉你这好消息。20 现在你要哑巴，不能说话，直到这事发生那天，因为你不信我的话，这话必按期限应验。”  

21 那时百姓等候 __PERSON_A__，奇怪他为什么在 __PLACE_A__ 里停留那么久。22 他出来不能说话，众人知道他在 __PLACE_A__ 里见异象，因他不断给他们比划，但不能说。  

23 服事完毕，他回家。24 之后他妻子 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕，藏了五个月。25 她说：“这事是 __MASTER_A__ 为我做的，他这几日向我施恩，除掉我在民中的羞辱。”  

先知 __PERSON_F__ 出生预告  
26 在 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕第六个月时，__MOST_HIGH_A__ 差天使 __MESSENGER_B__ 到 __REGION_A__ 乡里 __VILLAGE_A__，27 到一个许配给名叫 __PERSON_E__ 的人 —— 他是 __KING_A__ 的后裔的童贞女那儿。童贞女名叫 __PERSON_D__。28 天使对她说：“问安，你蒙恩宠， __MASTER_A__ 与你同在。”  

29 __PERSON_D__ 因他的话很忧愁，思考那问安是何意。30 天使说：“不要怕，__PERSON_D__，你在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前蒙恩。31 你要怀孕生子，给他起名叫 __PERSON_F__。32 他将伟大，被称为 __HONORED_A__ 的子。 __MASTER_A__ __MOST_HIGH_A__ 要赐他他父亲 __KING_A__ 的宝座，33 他要作 __ANCESTOR_B__ 子孙永远的王，他的国永不断。”  

34 __PERSON_D__ 问天使：“我没有男人，这事怎能成？”  

35 天使回答：“ __SPIRIT_A__ 要临到你， __HONORED_A__ 能力要蔽庇你，因此将要生的圣者要称为 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子。36 连你亲戚 __PERSON_B__ 老年怀孕，她被说不能生的已怀六个月。37 因为 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的话绝不落空。”  

38 __PERSON_D__ 说：“我是 __MASTER_A__ 的婢女，愿照你的话成就。”天使就离开她。  

__PERSON_D__ 访问 __PERSON_B__  
39 当时 __PERSON_D__ 预备急速往犹太山区小镇，40 进了 __PERSON_A__ 家，向 __PERSON_B__ 问安。41 __PERSON_B__ 听见 __PERSON_D__ 问安，腹中的婴孩跳动， __PERSON_B__ 被充满了 __SPIRIT_A__。42 她大声说：“妇女中你有福，你所怀的孩子也有福！43 我凭什么得这样恩惠，我主的母亲到我这里来？44 你问安的话一入我耳，我腹中的孩子就欢跳。45 因为信 __MASTER_A__ 应允她的日子是有福的！”  

__PERSON_D__ 颂歌  
46 __PERSON_D__ 说：  

“我的心尊主为大，  
47 我的灵因救主 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 欢喜，  
48 因他顾念他婢女的卑微，  
从此万代要称我有福。  
49 大能者为我成就大事，  
他的名为圣。  
50 他向敬畏他的人怀怜悯，  
直到世世代代。  
51 他以膀臂施展大能，  
把骄傲的人心思散开。  
52 他从宝座打倒君王，  
却高举卑微人。  
53 他使饥饿的人得美食，  
使富足的人空手而去。  
54 他帮助了他的仆人 __PEOPLE_A__，  
想起怜悯，  
55 照着他向祖先 __ANCESTOR_A__ 和后裔永远所立的约。”  

56 __PERSON_D__ 在 __PERSON_B__ 住了约三个月，就回家去了。  

先知 __PERSON_C__ 出生  
57 到了生孩子的日期，__PERSON_B__ 生了儿子。58 邻居亲属听说 __MASTER_A__ 大大发怜悯她，就一同喜乐。  

59 第八天要给孩子行割礼，按父亲 __PERSON_A__ 的名要起名，60 母亲说：“不可！他要叫 __PERSON_C__。”  

61 他们说：“你亲戚中没有叫这个名的。”  

62 就向父亲打手势，问想给孩子起什么名。63 父亲要写字板，众人惊讶，他写“他名叫 __PERSON_C__。”64 马上他的口开了，舌头也松了，能说话称赞 __MOST_HIGH_A__。65 周围的人都惧怕，犹太山区的人都谈论这事。66 凡听见的就想：“这孩子将成什么呢？”因 __MASTER_A__ 与他同在。  

__PERSON_A__ 颂歌  
67 他父亲 __PERSON_A__ 被 __SPIRIT_A__ 充满，预言说：  

68 “应当称颂 __MASTER_A__，就是 __PEOPLE_A__ 的 __MOST_HIGH_A__，  
因他眷顾他的百姓救赎他们。  
69 他为我们兴起救恩的角，  
在他仆人 __KING_A__ 家中，  
70 （正如古时圣先知所说），  
71 从我们仇敌和恨我们人的手中救赎我们，  
72 纪念他向祖先所应许的怜悯，  
73 他向我们父祖 __ANCESTOR_A__ 所起的誓言：  
74 救我们脱离仇敌之手，  
使我们终身在他面前圣洁公义，  
75 毫无惧怕侍奉他。  

76 孩子啊，你必称为 __HONORED_A__ 的先知，  
你要在 __MASTER_A__ 面前预备道路，  
77 给百姓知识救赎，  
赦免罪过，  
78 因我们 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 怜悯心肠，  
79 清晨的日光将从天降临照亮黑暗和死荫里的人，  
引导我们脚走平安路。”  

80 孩子渐长强壮，充满[d] 灵，在旷野生活，直到向 __PEOPLE_A__ 显现。
